subject.title: macOS app: dashboard fails silently with unresolved ${OPENCLAW_GATEWAY_TOKEN} placeholder when env var not in app's environment, with no in-app recovery path

question: Which linked PR should become the canonical fix path for this macOS dashboard auth placeholder lockout?
rationale: The issue is source-reproducible, but multiple open PRs overlap the same root cause and some only address gateway-side behavior or the final URL symptom; choosing the landing branch requires maintainer coordination.

options.title: Review the strongest native macOS candidate first
options.body: Start with https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101375 because its body claims SecretRef-aligned native resolver coverage and macOS CI, then require real Finder/Dock plus LaunchAgent proof before merge.

options.title: Adopt another linked macOS PR
options.body: Choose another open linked PR if its diff and proof better preserve remote behavior, local LaunchAgent fallback, and actionable dashboard recovery.

options.title: Open a replacement only if candidates stall
options.body: Keep this issue open and avoid a new fix PR unless the existing linked branches cannot be brought to a landable state.
